αἰδοῖ: αἰδώς — reverence, modesty, courtesy; fem. dat. sg., of manner: ’with modesty’
αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἴθ: αἴθε — would that; epic wish particle + opt., elided (αἴθ’ = αἴθε; = εἰ γάρ, αἲ γάρ)
αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fire-faced, sparkling (of wine, lit. αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’face’); masc. acc. sg. · also of smoke, masc. acc. sg. (αἴθοπα καπνόν ’fiery smoke’)
αἴσιμα: αἴσιμος — fitting, right, according to what is destined; neut. acc. pl., object of εἰδώς: ’what is fitting’ · also object of τίσειν: ’everything that is fitting, what is due’ · also object of τίουσι, neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’the proper deeds’ (αἴσιμα ἔργ’ ἀνθρώπων)
αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive in agreement with an unexpressed ’we’: ’we ourselves’ (αὐτοὶ βῆμεν ’we ourselves stepped out’) · also in agreement with an unexpressed ’you’: ’you yourselves’ (αὐτοὶ δ’ ὀτρύνεσθε ’and you yourselves rouse yourselves’)
αὐτόθι: αὐτόθι — here, on the spot, right there; adv.
αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼ … αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’you yourself’ (ὄφρα καὶ αὐτός ’so that you too yourself’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’him(self)’ · also reinforcing σε: ’you yourself’ (σ’ αὐτὸν) · also acc. sg. reinforcing an unexpressed 1st-person pronoun: ’me myself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ ἐνθάδ’ ἔχουσα ’keeping me myself here’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, after a preposition: ἀμφ’ αὐτὸν ’around him’
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’) · also used alone as a plain personal pronoun, ’him’, not reinforcing anything (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ μηχανόωνται ’are plotting against him’) · also with a noun, ’own, very’, in the dat. of accompaniment: αὐτῷ φάρει ’with the cloak itself, cloak and all’ · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοὶ αὐτῷ) · also plain pronoun of a thing, ’it’, after a preposition (ἀμφ’ αὐτῷ ’around it’)

βάλλον: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαλλον): ’were casting, threw’
βίη: βίη — might, bodily strength, force; fem. nom. sg.
βεβήκει: βαίνω — go, walk, step; plpf. 3 sg. with simple past force (Homeric pluperfect): ’had gone, went’
βορέαο: Βορέης — Boreas, the North Wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Βορέου)
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
γένοιο: γίγνομαι — become; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid.: ’you might become’, in a wish (εἰ … γένοιο ’if only you could become’)
γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg.
γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαφυρῇ: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed out; fem. dat. sg.
δέρματ: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. acc. pl., elided (δέρματ’ = δέρματα)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δεσποίνης: δέσποινα — mistress, lady; fem. gen. sg.
δευήσεαι: δεύομαι — lack, be in need of (+ gen.); fut. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δεήσῃ): ’you will lack’
διέχευαν: διαχέω — pour apart, cut up (a carcass); aor. 3 pl.: ’they cut her apart’
διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg.

δόμονδε: δόμος — house; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to, towards’: ’homeward’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν before a vowel) — in, on; + dat.
εἰπεῖν: εἶπον (aor. of φημί/λέγω, ’say, speak’) — say, tell; aor. inf. act., standing for an imperative: ’go and tell’ · also aor. inf. dependent on an adjective or wish, ’to tell’ (ποτιφωνήεις … εἰπεῖν ’able to tell’)
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰσῆγον: εἰσάγω — lead in, bring in; impf. 3 pl., augmented (root’s α lengthens to η): ’they led in’
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. εἴθ: εἴτε — whether, or; correlative conj., elided and aspirated (εἴθ’ = εἴτε)
εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took up (for herself)’ · also with ἐκ in tmesis: ’took away from’ (ἐκ … εἵλετο)
εἵματ: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl., elided (εἵματ’ = εἵματα)
εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: εἵματα γάρ ῥ’ ἐβάρυνε ’for the clothes weighed him down’
εἶπέ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., accented εἶπέ before a following enclitic (τε)
εὐνήν: εὐνή — bed, bedding, marriage-bed; fem. acc. sg. · also of an animal’s lair, den (ἑὴν εἰσήλυθεν εὐνήν ’came into his own lair’, of the lion in the simile)
εὔμαιε: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. voc. sg.

θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg. · also life, the breath of life

κήδετο: κήδω — trouble; mid. κήδομαι + gen. ’care for’; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκήδετο)
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
κακὴ: κακός — bad, harmful; adj., fem. nom. sg.
καρπαλίμως: καρπάλιμος — swift, nimble; adv. καρπαλίμως: ’swiftly, nimbly’
κατέλεξας: καταλέγω — recount, tell in order; aor. 2 sg.: ’you have recounted’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’)
κείμην: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκείμην): ’I lay’
κείνου: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. gen. sg.
κελεύει: κελεύω — bid, urge, order; pres. 3 sg.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’)
κεφαλὴν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg. · also periphrasis for the person: ’such a man’ (τοίην κεφαλήν, of Ajax)
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κλῦτε: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic: ’hear!’
κοιμήσαντο: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. lie down to sleep; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they lay down to sleep’
κοιμηθῆναι: κοιμάω — put to sleep; aor. pass. inf.: ’to lie down to sleep, go to bed’
κρειῶν: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. gen. pl., epic κρειῶν with ει for ε (= Attic κρεῶν)
κτήσατο: κτάομαι — acquire, get; aor. 3 sg. mid.
κτεάτεσσιν: κτέαρ — possession, property; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
λήθετ: λήθομαι — forget; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (λήθετ’ = λήθετο), + gen.: ’forgot’
λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
λαέρταο: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
λαερτιάδη: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; voc. sg.
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’) · also governed by ἐκ: ἔκ ... λαῶν ’from the people’ · also partitive gen. after a relative: οἵ ... λαῶν ἡμετέρων ’those of our people who’ · also partitive gen. after an adjective of rank: πάντων ἀριδείκετε λαῶν ’most distinguished of all the people’ · also gen. governed by πρόσθεν: ’before (the city and) the people’
λόχον: λόχος — ambush, body of men lying in wait; masc. acc. sg. (of the men hidden inside the wooden horse)

μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’
μέγας: μέγας — great, big, grown; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’grown’ · also plain attributive adj., masc. nom. sg., ’great, huge’ (μέγας σῦς ’a great boar’), not predicate

μία: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg.
μίστυλλόν: μιστύλλω — cut into small pieces; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they cut into small pieces’
μεγάλην: μέγας — great, mighty; fem. acc. sg.
μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μελέων: μέλος — limb; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μελῶν): ’of the limbs’
μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic μετεῖπε)

μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)

μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)

μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv.
νύμφῃσι: νύμφη — nymph; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic νύμφαις; Ionic η for α)
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
ξείνων: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the strangers’
ξύλα: ξύλον — wood, firewood; neut. acc. pl.

παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’) · also + acc., of motion, ’past, along, beside’ (παρ’ Μίμαντα ’past Mimas’)
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
πατρὶ: πατήρ — father; masc. dat. sg., governed by ὁμοῖοι ’like’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person told: ’to (her) father’ (ἀγγείλειε ... πατρὶ φίλῳ ’report to her dear father’) · also masc. dat. sg. in apposition to Zeus: Διὶ πατρὶ ’to father Zeus’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the god prayed to: εὔχεο πατρὶ Ποσειδάωνι ’pray to your father Poseidon’ · also masc. dat. sg. after παρά: ’beside (their) father’ (παρὰ πατρὶ φίλῳ) · also masc. dat. sg. object of χαριζόμενος: ’pleasing (his own) father’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περικήδετο: περικήδομαι — care deeply for, be much concerned about; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic περιεκήδετο) + gen.
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
πλέονας: πλείων (comparative of πολύς) — more, greater in number; masc. acc. pl., epic πλέονας (= Attic πλείονας)
ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
πολλαὶ: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.
πολυμήχαν: πολυμήχανος — many-devising; voc. sg., elided (πολυμήχαν’ = πολυμήχανε)
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πολύφρονα: πολύφρων — of many counsels, much-minded; masc. acc. sg.
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’ · also + dat., ’on, upon’: ποτὶ χθονί ’on the ground’
προέηκεν: προΐημι — send forth, let go; aor. 3 sg., epic προέηκεν (= Attic προῆκε): ’he sent forth’ (of the wind, θεὸς προέηκεν ἀῆναι)
προκείμενα: πρόκειμαι — lie before, be set out; pres. part. neut. nom./acc. pl.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσέφης: προσφημί — speak to, address; impf. 2 sg. (the poet’s address to Eumaeus; the usual 3 sg. is προσέφη)
προσηύδων: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 1 sg. (καί μιν ... προσηύδων ’I addressed him’) · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they addressed’ (ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδων)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πτόλιν: πτόλις (epic by-form of πόλις) — city; acc. sg.
πυκνά: πυκνός — thick, close-set, dense; neut. acc. pl.
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πόσιος: πόσις — drinking; gen. sg. (abstract noun, distinct from πόσις ’husband’)
πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς because followed by a further enclitic (με): ’lest he somehow...’
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’) · also a preposition + dat., ’beside’ (πὰρ πυρί ’beside the fire’)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σίτου: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg.
σευ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic enclitic (= Attic σοῦ): ’your, of you’
συβῶτα: συβώτης — swineherd; masc. voc. sg., epic -α (in apposition to Εὔμαιε)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σχέθε: ἔχω — hold, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔσχε)
σύες: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig; masc./fem. nom. pl.
σὰ: σός — your (sg.); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’your (knees)’
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’ · also in ἦ τέ, a strengthened affirmation: ’truly’ (ἦ τέ μ’ ἔφαντο ’who truly said’)
τέρπεο: τέρπω — delight, gladden; mid. enjoy oneself; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic τέρπου)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’)
τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταλαπείριον: ταλαπείριος — much-enduring, wretched; masc. acc. sg.
ταφίων: Τάφιοι — the Taphians, an island people led by Mentes; gen. pl.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj. · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: τοῖον … ἔρνος (acc.), τοῖον … δόρυ (nom.) ’such a shoot, such a trunk’
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: masc./neut. dat. pl. ’in which, with which’ (τετυγμένα, τοῖς ἐνάμελγεν ’well-made, in which he milked’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: ’the’ (ἰχθύσι τοῖς ὀλίγοισι ’for the little fishes’)
τοῖσδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’these’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τρίχα: τρίχα — in three ways, threefold; adv.
τόνδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstr. pron., masc. acc. sg., elided (τόνδ’ = τόνδε)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τἆλλα: ἄλλος — other; τἆλλα, crasis of τὰ ἄλλα: the rest, the other things; neut. nom./acc. pl.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’)
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cattle · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the fruits · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the nymphs and of the Sirens · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: fem. acc. pl. ’which’ (ἀπειλάων, τὰς … ἐπηπείλησε ’threats which he threatened’) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the swine
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also predicate adjective: ’dear’ (φίλος ἦεν Ἰήσων ’Jason was dear (to her)’)
φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; fem. dat. sg.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φυκτὰ: φυκτός — to be escaped, escapable (verbal adj. of φεύγω); neut. nom. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg.
χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’he rejoiced’ (χαῖρε φήμῃ ’rejoiced at the omen-word’) · also the imperative at parting: ’farewell’ · also with a dative of cause, ’be glad’ (χαῖρε … φιλότητι ’be glad in love’)
χείρεσσιν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν
χειμὼν: χειμών — winter, winter storm; masc. nom. sg.
χεῖμα: χεῖμα — winter, cold; neut. acc. sg., acc. of time: ’in winter’
χλαίνας: χλαῖνα — a thick cloak, mantle; fem. acc. pl.
χλαῖνάν: χλαῖνα — a thick woollen cloak; fem. acc. sg.
χλαῖναι: χλαῖνα — thick woollen cloak (also used as a blanket); fem. nom. pl.
χλαῖναν: χλαῖνα — cloak, mantle; fem. acc. sg.
χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ
χρυσόθρονος: χρυσόθρονος — golden-throned; adj., fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses (an old alternative derives the second element from θρόνα ’embroidered flowers’)
ψυχή: ψυχή — soul, ghost, shade; fem. nom. sg.
ἀγαμέμνονι: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. dat. sg.
ἀλφίτου: ἄλφιτον — barley-groats, barley-meal; neut. gen. sg.
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’) · also with ὀστεόφιν, ’around’ (ἀμφ’ ὀστεόφιν θὶς ’a heap around the bones’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀντιάσαντα: ἀντιάω — meet, meet with, come by (+ gen.); aor. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱκέτην: ’one who has met with’
ἀνόρουσε: ἀνορούω — spring up, leap up; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἀνώρουσε)
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., a present formed on the perf. stem: ’bids’ (ἐποτρύνει καὶ ἀνώγει ’urges and bids’)
ἀολλέα: ἀολλής — all together, in a body; adj., neut. acc. pl., uncontracted epic (= Attic ἀολλῆ)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπαρχόμενος: ἀπάρχομαι — make the first offering; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀποιχομένοιο: ἀποίχομαι — be gone away, be departed; pres. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀργιόδοντες: ἀργιόδους — white-tusked; masc. nom. pl. (epithet of boars)
ἀργιόδοντος: ἀργιόδους — white-toothed; adj., masc./fem. gen. sg., epithet of a boar or pig
ἀσπασίως: ἀσπάσιος — glad, welcome; adv. ἀσπασίως: ’gladly, joyfully’
ἀτιμάζουσι: ἀτιμάζω — dishonour, slight; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic ἀτιμάζουσιν), + acc.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀτρεΐδῃ: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic, of Agamemnon); masc. dat. sg.
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἄη: ἄημι — blow; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἄη, ἔπνει): ’blew’
ἄκοντα: ἄκων — javelin, spear; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλας: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. acc. pl.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄμεινον: ἀγαθός — good; comparative ἀμείνων, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’better’
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄνωγον: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); past (impf. or plpf.) 3 pl. or 1 sg., unaugmented (augmented ἤνωγον): ’they bade, I bade’
ἄπο: ἀπό — away from, from; + gen.; accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (anastrophe: φίλων ἄπο) · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὀλέσαντ’ ἄπο = ἀπολέσαντα ’having lost’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl., subject or object of a verb: ’all things’ (τελευτηθῆναι ἅπαντα ’that all things were fulfilled’)
ἐάσει: ἐάω — allow, permit, let be; fut. 3 sg.: ’will allow’
ἐγών: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., epic form with ν (= ἐγώ)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐθέλῃ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., in an εἰ clause without κε: ’is willing’
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented (non-enclitic emphatic): ’to me’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — here, to this place; adv., with -δε suffix of direction (’in this place’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’)
ἐπέοιχ: ἔπεοικε — it is fitting, befits (+ dat.); perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense, elided (ἐπέοιχ’ = ἐπέοικε)
ἐπικεύσω: ἐπικεύθω — hide further, keep back, conceal in addition; fut. 1 sg.
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’)
ἐπῆλθε: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, arrive; aor. 2 3 sg. (same form in Attic)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθῆτος: ἐσθής — clothing, raiment; fem. gen. sg., gen. of want with δευήσεαι
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
ἐόντ: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐόντ’ = ἐόντα), epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος): ’being, alive’
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑοῖσιν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’
ἑπόμην: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 1 sg. mid. (= Attic εἱπόμην): ’I followed’
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form), address: ’companions!’
ἑτοῖμα: ἕτοιμος — ready, at hand; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., predicate: ἑτοῖμα τέτυκτο ’had proved real, had come true’
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’placed’
ἔλθῃσιν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic ἔλθῃ): ’may come’
ἔμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμπεδος: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unfailing; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg., predicate · also masc. nom. sg., predicate (νοῦς … ἔμπεδος ’the mind was steady’)
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); acc. sg.
ἔστησαν: ἵστημι — set up, stand; aor. 3 pl. of ἔστην, intransitive: ’took their stand, stood’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold, keep to; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον) · also impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’I had, I was carrying’
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘holding’ · also with ἄλγεα, masc. acc. sg.: ’suffering, enduring’ (κρατέρ’ ἄλγε’ ἔχοντα ’beset by harsh pains’)
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕννυσθαι: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; pres. inf. mid.: ’to put on, wear’
ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ: ’they put away (desire)’
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠῶθέν: ἠῶθεν — from dawn, at dawn, in the morning; adv.
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl. ’we’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’
ἤλθομεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 pl.: ’we came’
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱκόμεσθα: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we came’
ἴαλλον: ἰάλλω — send forth, put out (the hand); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
ἴμεναι: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι): ’to go’
ἵστατο: ἵστημι — set, stand; impf. 3 sg. mid./intrans. (neut. pl. subject with sg. verb): ’were standing’ · also with ἀνά in tmesis, masc. sg. subject: ’stood up, rose’ (ἀνὰ … ἵστατο)
ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀδυσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀνείαθ: ὄνειαρ — good thing, benefit; of food, neut. acc. pl., elided (ὀνείαθ’ = ὀνείατα)
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
ὀρχήσασθαι: ὀρχέομαι — dance; aor. inf. mid.: ’to dance’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place (distinct from ὅτε ’when’, similarly elided ὅτ’) · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — when; temporal conj.: ὅθ’ ἑὸς δόμος ἀμφεκάλυψε ’when his own house sheltered (me)’
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅνδε: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ὅνδε δόμονδε ’to his own house’
ὅππῃ: ὅππῃ — in whatever way, wherever; epic relative adv. (= Attic ὅπῃ)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’) · also in an indirect question, ’what’ (ὅττι ἑ κήδοι ’what was troubling him’) · also conj. ’that, because’, introducing a clause (ὅττι μιν ὣς ὑπέδεκτο ’that he had received him so’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὑός: ὗς — pig, boar; masc./fem. gen. sg. ὑός
ὑῶν: ὗς — pig, swine; masc./fem. gen. pl. (Attic ὑῶν)
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, in; postpositive prep. + dat., anastrophe (ὕπνῳ ὕπο = ὑπὸ ὕπνῳ): ’in (sweet sleep)’ · also as a preverb apart from its verb (tmesis): φυγὼν ὕπο = ὑποφυγών ’having escaped’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ ’having escaped the pitiless day’) · also + gen. of agent, postpositive: Κικόνων ὕπο ’at the hands of the Cicones’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’arose’ (of a wind springing up) · also of a person: ’set out, started’ (ὦρτο πόλινδ’ ἴμεν ’set out to go to the city’)
ὧν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. pl. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: of whom, whose; gen. pl., partitive (τοὺς δ’ ὧν ἐθέλει ’whomever he wishes’), not the possessive
ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for which, to which’ (referring back to the ship, νηῦς) · also ’on which’, of a road: τὴν ὁδὸν ᾗ δὴ ’the journey on which’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀλόχῳ (ᾗ … ἀλόχῳ ’his own wife’) · also relative adverb of place, ’where, by which way’ (ᾗ οἱ Ἀθήνη πέφραδε ’where Athena had pointed out to him’)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
